subtitle: 一句话，现场造一张卡
description: 输入一句话，应用在本机识别出时间/地点/类型，现场长出一张按场景各不相同的卡，并把确认过的卡与偏好写进本机长期记忆（memory.json）。也可以在导入时绑定一个房间，直接读到那里的最近消息，挑一条就造卡；读到你的 Matrix 名字后，还会把聊天里「你自己发的」那几条标出来。不依赖任何服务也完整可用。
release_notes: 0.7.2 - adds matrix.profile, so the app knows which messages in the room are your own and marks them. The two read switches stay ON (matrix.read_messages, octos.session.history); recognition stays on-device; model.complete is implemented and locally verified but left off, because Rinx grants the capability name `model` while the service is `model.complete` and so refuses it - enable it on a host that serves the model service.
